blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mindanao could face a potential repeat of a power crisis from over a decade ago, as the country’s grid operator anticipates that it will deplete its excess electricity capacity by 2028. Cynthia Alabanza, assistant vice president at the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP), attributed the bleak scenario to the lack of new power plant deployment.
